# #54 — feat: explicit namespace param on core write tools

Parent: #53 (Requirement 1)

## Goal
Add explicit `namespace` param to core write tools so agent writes land in the correct namespace instead of defaulting to `collab`.

## Changes
- New `src/namespace-policy.ts` module — `canWriteNamespace(auth, targetNamespace)` enforcing: admin/n8n → any namespace, agent → own + collab, discord → own only
- Add `namespace` param to `log_thought`, `log_decision`, `upsert_person`, `session_save`
- Default namespace to `auth.clientId` when omitted
- Migration: make unique indexes namespace-scoped (content_hash, person_name)
- Retrofit `canWriteNamespace()` on session tools that already accept namespace but don't enforce policy

## Acceptance criteria
- `log_thought` with `namespace=bilby` stores in bilby namespace, searchable only there
- Agent token denied when writing to another agent's namespace
- Admin can write to any namespace
- Existing consumers unaffected (namespace defaults to clientId)
